correctness.rationale: For −c nonsquare take α²=−c in F_(q²). By tower irreducibility, (A²+c) is irreducible over Fq iff A−α is irreducible over the extension; its discriminant x+4α for x=a²−4b has quadratic character of norm x²+16c. Each a gives a bijection b↔x. The constant-branch sum χ(x²+16c)=−1; the joint indicator gives q/4(q+2+S). Squaring-map weighting 1+χ(t) turns S into −1 plus the cubic trace ∑χ(X(X+c)(X+d)), hence q#E/4. Distinct 0,−c,−d give a nonsingular curve with all rational 2-torsion. Independent direct quartic factor checks for every (c,d) over F3,F5,F7,F11 match this formula, but only the field-tower argument covers arbitrary odd prime powers.
